variables.description: The amount of income subject to tax.
A person who is the head of a household as defined in section 2(b).
variables.supporting_span: head of a household (as defined in section 2(b))

predicates.description: Identifies if a person is a head of household.
predicates.supporting_span: every head of a household (as defined in section 2(b))

predicates.description: The amount of income subject to tax.
predicates.supporting_span: the taxable income of every head of a household

predicates.description: The tax determined for the taxable income of a head of household.
predicates.supporting_span: There is hereby imposed on the taxable income of every head of a household (as defined in section 2(b)) a tax determined in accordance with the following:

rules.supporting_span: 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $29,600
rules.explanation: If taxable income is under or equal to $29,600, tax is 15% of that amount.

rules.supporting_span: $4,440, plus 28% of the excess over $29,600 if the taxable income is over $29,600 but not over $76,400
rules.explanation: If taxable income is between $29,601 and $76,400, tax is $4,440 plus 28% of the amount exceeding $29,600.

rules.supporting_span: $17,544, plus 31% of the excess over $76,400 if the taxable income is over $76,400 but not over $127,500
rules.explanation: If taxable income is between $76,401 and $127,500, tax is $17,544 plus 31% of the amount exceeding $76,400.

rules.supporting_span: $33,385, plus 36% of the excess over $127,500 if the taxable income is over $127,500 but not over $250,000
rules.explanation: If taxable income is between $127,501 and $250,000, tax is $33,385 plus 36% of the amount exceeding $127,500.

rules.supporting_span: $77,485, plus 39.6% of the excess over $250,000 if the taxable income is over $250,000.
rules.explanation: If taxable income exceeds $250,000, tax is $77,485 plus 39.6% of the amount exceeding $250,000.
